_meta.indication: LEQSELVI is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with severe alopecia areata.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial; 8 mg, 12 mg, or placebo oral tablets BID randomized 3:5:2, for 24 weeks.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults 18 to 65 years with moderate to severe AA (SALT score of 50 or greater at baseline, i.e., loss of 50% or greater scalp hair).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving an absolute SALT score of ≤ 20 (at least 80% scalp hair coverage) at Week 24.
pivotal_trials.result: SALT ≤20 at Week 24: deuruxolitinib 8 mg 29.2% vs placebo 0.8% (12 mg 39.8%).

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial; deuruxolitinib 8 mg, 12 mg, or placebo oral tablets BID for 24 weeks; subjects randomized in a 1:2:1 ratio (12 mg BID : 8 mg BID : placebo), differing from CP543.3001's 3:5:2 ratio.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults 18 to 65 years with moderate to severe AA (SALT score ≥50, i.e., at least 50% scalp hair loss).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving an absolute SALT score of ≤ 20 at Week 24.
pivotal_trials.result: SALT ≤20 at Week 24: deuruxolitinib 8 mg 32.1% vs placebo 0.8% (12 mg 36.7%).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥1%): headache (12.4% vs 9.4% placebo), acne (10.0% vs 4.3%), nasopharyngitis (8.1% vs 6.7%), blood CPK increased (5.3% vs 2.2%). Serious risks (boxed) include serious infections, mortality, malignancy, MACE, and thrombosis.
target_moa: Deuruxolitinib is a small molecule JAK inhibitor (a deuterated isotopolog of ruxolitinib) that modulates an immune response through intracellular JAK1 and JAK2 signaling; it had greater inhibitory potency for JAK1, JAK2 and TYK2 relative to JAK3.

boxed_warning.content: Boxed warning: SERIOUS INFECTIONS, MORTALITY, MALIGNANCY, MAJOR ADVERSE CARDIOVASCULAR EVENTS (MACE) and THROMBOSIS.

rems.type: A REMS would not reduce the known risks; proposed labeling (prescribing information and Medication Guide) and routine pharmacovigilance were considered adequate.

companion_dx_detail: CYP2C9 genotype determination is required before initiation (LEQSELVI is contraindicated in CYP2C9 poor metabolizers), but an FDA-cleared or -approved test for detection of CYP2C9 variants is not currently available; a PMR (4655-7) requires establishing such an in-vitro diagnostic device.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was conducted because there were no complex regulatory issues warranting discussion with external experts.

basis.text: Breakthrough Therapy Designation had been granted (under IND 131423) but was rescinded (Rescind letter dated March 14, 2024) because the criteria for designation were no longer being met, since baricitinib and ritlecitinib had gained traditional approvals for the same proposed indication.

- Other drugs, baricitinib and ritlecitinib, gained traditional approvals on June 13, 2022, and June 23, 2023, respectively, for the same proposed indication as CTP-543.

requirement.text: 4655-4 Prospective pregnancy registry study: Collect global data from prospective pregnancy exposure registry/registries, preferably disease-based multiproduct pregnancy registry/registries, using a registry-based cohort study design to compare the maternal, fetal, and infant outcomes of women with Alopecia Areata exposed to deuruxolitinib during pregnancy with unexposed comparator population(s).

citations.quote: Collect global data from prospective pregnancy exposure registry/registries, preferably disease-based multiproduct pregnancy registry/registries, using a registry-based cohort study design to compare the maternal, fetal, and infant outcomes of women with Alopecia Areata exposed to deuruxolitinib during pregnancy with unexposed comparator population(s). The registry will identify and record pregnancy complications, major and minor congenital malformations, spontaneous abortion, stillbirths, pregnancy terminations, preterm births, small for-gestational-age births, and any other adverse outcomes, including postnatal growth and development. These outcomes will be assessed throughout pregnancy. Infant outcomes, including effects on postnatal growth and development, will be assessed through at least the first year of life.
